guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Identify Which Cohort You Fall Under
guide.description: Work out which of the three groups applies to you first. Substack and Channel 5 recipients claim by email through the official portal. TRUMP loss recipients never use it, since those tokens move through exchanges.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify the Contract Address and Domain
guide.description: The project lists its official Base contract as 0xB095274743941e953c746F9C228DA9c18Bb6ec29 . Verify it on the official LAPTOP website rather than a screener or a search result. Our crypto safety guide explains how fake claim pages work.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Open the Official Claim Portal
guide.description: Go to the LAPTOP claim portal and enter the email tied to your Substack or Channel 5 subscription. It shows your eligibility and allocation before you commit.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect an Email and Create an Embedded Wallet
guide.description: Connect an eligble Email adress, connect wallet if you have an allocation. With an embedded wallet, export your keys or move the tokens out afterwards, since access depends on that service staying up.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund the Wallet With ETH on Base
guide.description: A self-custody claim needs a little ETH on Base for gas. Buy ETH on Bybit and withdraw straight to Base, or move some across from another network using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Within the 30-Day Window
guide.description: Sign the claim transaction and confirm the tokens arrive. Read what you sign. A legitimate claim never asks for a seed phrase and never asks you to send funds first.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Your Exchange for the TRUMP Loss Share
guide.description: If you qualify through TRUMP losses, watch announcements from the exchange or app where you traded. Each venue sets its own rules, so allocations vary and some may sit out.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
